object.body:
${requester} has reassigned a task from ${previousOwner} to ${newOwner} for ${userName}'s ${source} account.

${newOwner} can find this task within the Task Manager.

Thanks,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
object.description: Sent when a user reassigns a provisioning task for a different user to complete.
object.name: Task Reassignment
object.subject: A task has been reassigned
